item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: A journey through states of water
item.stem: Meena's mother keeps a steel tumbler of drinking water in the freezer. After some hours the water becomes ice. The next day Meena leaves some ice cubes in a bowl in the kitchen, and they melt back into water. Her grandmother tells her that when wet clothes dry on the line, the water escapes into the air as vapour. Which statement about ice, liquid water and water vapour is correct?

options.A: Ice, liquid water and water vapour are three different substances, because they look and behave differently.
options.B: Ice, liquid water and water vapour are the same substance, water, present in three different states.
options.C: Ice and liquid water are the same substance, but water vapour is a different substance.
options.D: Water changes into a new substance when it freezes, but not when it evaporates.
